description: Upadek, the spirit of falling, one big bold diagonal shape filling the whole picture: a heavy grey-violet hooded figure plunging head first, a huge tattered cloak billowing upward behind it like two broken wings, two long arms stretched down with big clawed hands, two glowing white eyes in the dark hood, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, the figure alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
